hypothesis.statement: The real fix is adding "dist-swagger" to the hard-coded APPROVED_TOP_LEVEL set in tools/guards/repository-structure-gate.mjs, not editing the retention policy (iteration 1's hypothesis was mechanically wrong about the target file, though right that dist-swagger is a legitimate generated artifact from tools/scripts/build-swagger-static.mjs).

intendedChanges: Add the single string "dist-swagger" to the APPROVED_TOP_LEVEL Set literal in tools/guards/repository-structure-gate.mjs.
expectedOutcomes: node tools/guards/repository-structure-gate.mjs exits 0 with no UNAPPROVED_TOP_LEVEL warning for dist-swagger.

unexpectedResults: The task contract needed correction before repair: iteration 1 froze scope.allowedPaths to governance/cleanup/repository-retention-policy.json, but that file has no mechanical link to this guard's hard-coded list. Corrected the contract (new contractHash) before any repair executed under the wrong scope.

tools/remediation/scope/enforce-allowed-paths.mjs compares against git diff from source.baseSha to HEAD, which on a shared work branch (no isolated child branch was created for this small P3 task) includes every commit made since baseSha across unrelated waves, not just this repair. It reported 13 false OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_PATHS violations for already-committed, unrelated files. The real repair diff (working-tree only, uncommitted) was confirmed as exactly the one allowed file via `git status --short`. This is a real limitation of the scope tool's isolated-child-branch assumption when tasks execute directly on a shared work branch; recorded under improve.blindSpotsFound, not swept aside.

newFindings: repository-structure-gate.mjs owns its own APPROVED_TOP_LEVEL list independent of the cleanup retention policy JSON; the two are not linked.

enforce-allowed-paths.mjs and scope-expansion-gate.mjs assume per-task branch isolation from baseSha; they produce false positives when a task is repaired directly on a shared work branch that has since received unrelated commits.

blindSpotsFound: Scope-diff tools (enforce-allowed-paths.mjs, scope-expansion-gate.mjs) need either a per-task child branch to diff against, or a per-task frozen-index/tree comparison instead of baseSha..HEAD, to stay accurate when tasks are repaired directly on a shared work branch.
